[{"word":"show","pronun":"[ʃoʊ]","translation":"n. 显示；表演；炫耀

vi. 用带绑扎；给...镶边","audio":"band.mp3"},{"word":"bride","pronun":"[braɪd]","translation":"n. 新娘；姑娘，女朋友","audio":"bride.mp3"},{"word":"cake","pronun":"[keɪk]","translation":"n. 蛋糕；块状物；利益总额
